role.name: role
role.description: Apply a role action to a member

bot.noAction: You have no role action on this server.
bot.notMember: This member is not on the server.
bot.self: Not on yourself or on a bot.
bot.higher: This member manages the server: only someone who manages the server can change their roles.
bot.dangerous: One of the roles gives moderation rights: action blocked. Check it in the dashboard.
bot.failed: Kron could not change these roles: put the Kron role above them.
bot.nothing: No change (the member already had these roles).

web.intro: Your staff applies role actions with /role, without the “Manage Roles” permission: with it, a member could also delete or edit those roles.
web.actionsHint: Each action adds and removes roles at once. Members who manage the server can use them all.
web.name: Name
web.dangerous: ⚠️ {role} gives moderation rights: an action cannot give it.
web.logHint: Every action applied is noted there: who, to whom, which roles.
web.how: On Discord: /role member:@player, then click the action. Only the actions allowed to your role show.

errors.invalid_role: A chosen role no longer exists.
errors.role_too_high: Kron must be above the roles added or removed (Server settings → Roles).
errors.dangerous_role: An action gives a role with moderation rights: remove it.
